intent: Block a published caution appears only as attributed text. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** A named investigator's published caution, set as text on a screen with its byline
and date visible, in the register the critic's window uses. No face, no body, no room.

**Screen / system text — PUBLISHED, ATTRIBUTED:**
`SOME OF THE INCENTIVES ON A THIRD-PARTY INVESTIGATOR PUSH TOWARD MAXIMIZING THE APPEARANCE
OF ASSURANCE WITHOUT PROVIDING MEANINGFUL OVERSIGHT.`

**Action:** The strongest warning about the investigation comes from inside it.

**Provenance:** `documented` — attributed paraphrase of Beth Barnes' dated public writing,
registered in [`sources.md`](../../research/sources.md). She is describing the position of a
third-party investigator, not this book, and the page may not extend it to anyone she did
not name.
title: A published caution appears only as attributed text
